viewer_axes.x: 1D PCA projection of the color space for color photos, or the tone space for B&W photos
viewer_axes.y: 1D PCA projection of the geometry/composition space

feature_spec.selection_model: Same-mode selectable color-or-tone and geometry gates produce ordered distance ladders with anchor-first output

photo_modes.color: Default color photographs and muted-but-not-grayscale images
photo_modes.bw: Strict grayscale/near-grayscale photographs without concentrated colorful highlights
